title: AIOps Report
description: One shape for every kind of report. What a given kind is made of is decided by its template, which names the sections and says what belongs in each; this only fixes how a filled-in section is expressed. The shape is fixed because n8n's structured output parser takes a static schema, and it is the writer's contract rather than the document's layout: headings come from the template, not from here.

id.description: The id of the template section being filled in. Sections are matched on this rather than on their heading, so the writer never has to reproduce a heading and cannot rename one.

body.description: Prose for sections that read as a paragraph. Null for sections that are a list.

items.description: Entries for sections that read as a list. Empty for sections that are prose. A section with neither is dropped from the report rather than printed empty.

label.description: Short qualifier printed ahead of the text, such as a confidence for a cause candidate. Null when the entry needs none.

counter_evidence_refs.description: Evidence that argues against this entry. Usually empty; a cause candidate is where it earns its place.
